message: Turn 42 fixed at d512aff186ede4efae8d623325179e3834c76ff1, Dispatcher 2.2.13. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_rebind.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_restore.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_control_rebind.py test_control_page.py test_control_restore.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_control_rebind.py printed test_control_rebind: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK and inferTurnRole: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_page.py printed test_control_page: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_restore.py printed test_control_restore: OK, exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0. Rebind semantics: a rendered conversation-load failure, including 'Не удалось загрузить этот разговор' and English equivalents, is diag=unavailable. Empty messages or a missing composer alone do not rebind. A confirmed unavailable saved URL may be rebound once even if recovery_used is true. The separate latch is rebind_for_url, rebind_attempted_at, rebind_count, and rebind_status. recovery_used, recovery_reason, recovered_from, bootstrap history, and GitHub state are not reset. Rebind opens at most one new page at ChatGPT home, checks the composer, sends CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP once on that new page, waits at most 20 seconds for a new conversation URL, and writes that observed URL with replaced_from. Signed out, no composer, or no new URL fails closed. Later polls do not create another page. An unrelated ChatGPT conversation is never navigated, and bootstrap is not sent to the old chat. Success clears only the restore latch. After the new chat is ready, the pending wake is sent once under the existing de-duplication. CHECK_INTERVAL stays 5. The 2.2.10 raw-to-api failover is unchanged. Logs contain tokens only, not message text. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
